title: What is LinkedIn's "Fair Chance" Filter? 🔎
description:
If you have a criminal record and are job searching we understand it is much more difficult. On job boards you’re using look for a filtet called “Fair Chance Employer”. There typically are fewer jobs under this filter but it will only show employers who have pledged to consider applicants with a criminal record. Thanks for the question! #fairchance #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #linkedintips
